scripts.release:check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm run build && pnpm audit --audit-level=high && pnpm -r --filter='./packages/*' --filter='./apps/*' publish --dry-run --no-git-checks
scripts.link:bin: node -e 'const fs=require("fs"),path=require("path"),os=require("os");const binDirs=[path.join(os.homedir(),".local/bin"),path.join(os.homedir(),"Library/pnpm/bin")];const targets={bk:path.resolve("./bin/bk"),berkelium:path.resolve("./bin/berkelium")};for(const dir of binDirs){if(fs.existsSync(dir)){for(const [name,target] of Object.entries(targets)){const link=path.join(dir,name);try{fs.unlinkSync(link);}catch{};try{fs.symlinkSync(target,link);console.log("Linked",name,"->",link);}catch(e){console.warn("Could not link",name,"in",dir,e.message);}}}}'
